reuse.why: Bank lookup, link validation and unlink cleanup are shared, but the new linking helper serves only Fintegra while duplicating existing provider workflows.

duplication.why: The diff adds another account-linking workflow and another substantially duplicated transaction downloader.

placement.why: Link orchestration, transaction downloading, server configuration and provider models follow the tree's existing module boundaries.

scope.why: The changes are focused on the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration and supporting tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Shared validation and cleanup improve ownership, but a single-consumer generic linking helper leaves maintainers updating parallel implementations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The pre-change tree has no shared account-linking or transaction-download abstraction that this change bypasses, and findOrCreateBank is reused.

disguised_duplication.where: app.ts: linkBankSyncAccount parameterizes the existing SimpleFin-style linking body but leaves its original copies intact, making another copy appear to be shared infrastructure.

abstraction_drift.where: claimBankAccount gains replaceExistingLink and its replacement branch; the five existing provider handlers retain their own linking implementations instead of using the newly introduced linkBankSyncAccount.
